author: Eklip_Z
body:
Hello everyone! :D

Before I start this you need to remember that I have been away for quite a while so I won't be as informed as most of you about the future of Avicus. Also, if this is considered, I don't expect it to be implemented in the next few weeks or even months so without further ado I present a some suggestions.

Avicade
Now I'm not sure if this was just taken down temporarily or because it just wasn't played enough, but it was a really good gamemode. It provided some really fun games to everyone including those who aren't that talented at pvp (cri.)

Nebula Shop 
Now I know I'm gonna get called out for this one but why was it removed? Say you're hiding in a tower with full diamond armour with very small health, the opposing team all around you trying to steal your armour. The ability to invest in some golden apples with your credits to stop you from yelling into teamspeak "I'M GONNA DIE," would be a great feature to have back. 

One hit, one kill TDM
As much as this was a battle between the people with very low ping and then the others with high ping having a slight disadvantage (cri,) I personally enjoyed these games. They were fast paced games that brought in a new concept, replacing rushing or fancy strafes & combos with new tactics.

Prestiges 
Rilo made a topic https://avicus.net/forums/332bf0636 and some good points were made about how it creates goals for players which does make games more enjoyable. 


That's all I had on the top of my head right now. If you have ideas feel free to reply with some.

title: Some Suggestions

replies.author: Coco_stag
replies.body:
Avicade:

I actually never got to play this before the omega update! I never even wanted to try it out, but steven in the map testing event was settings some avicade maps and they were really fun! 1+ to this idea.

Nebula Shop:

Although this isn't the most important thing it was a good idea. I hate to kill farming and someone kills steals me thus I keep losing golden apples because I am eating them while not getting them back! This is only 1 reason why the shop is important.

One hit 1 kill TDM:

I loved this! I am pretty sure it was removed because of biased ping and it lagged the server. This was a good thing though, because I fly all over the map with my aussie ping and wack everyone :D I guess it goes both ways


Prestiges: 

awww ye!
